jsn_install_guidance.note: Use current Node.js LTS and npm on Windows, macOS, or Linux. No connection or credentials needed for public documentation.

jsn_update_guidance.note: Check your installed version first: -dev. versions use @dev; stable uses npm latest. Choose the matching channel unless intentionally switching. No pinned version supplied.

jsn_remove_guidance.note: Removes the npm-installed global package and command link, not user-created JSN profiles, credentials, documentation caches, or separately installed agent skills. This tool performs no removal. Manage retained data separately with explicit human review.

jsn_bug_guidance.note: Search existing issues first. Include JSN version/channel, OS/Node version, reproduction steps, expected and actual behavior. Redact credentials, instance URLs and private records. No repository-specific issue templates currently exist; use the chooser or blank issue. Human review and GitHub sign-in/submission required.

jsn_feature_request_guidance.note: Search existing issues first. Describe use case, desired behavior, alternatives, and acceptance criteria. Redact credentials, instance URLs and private records. No repository-specific issue templates currently exist; use the chooser or blank issue. Human review and GitHub sign-in/submission required.

jsn_docs_search.note: Feature catalog only; use dedicated tools for installation/update/removal.
